text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc on Wednesday criticized Giddings & Lewis Inc for setting a special shareholders meeting for September 11, a date that it said was too late.

"We are outraged, but unfortunately not surprised, that you have chosen to delay until September 11th the special meeting of the shareholders of Giddings & Lewis... that we and a number of other large shareholders of G&L have requested in connection with Harnischfeger's offer to purchase all of G&L's outstanding shares at $19 per share in cash," Jeffrey Grade, Harnischfeger chairman, said in a statement.
On Tuesday, Harnischfeger said that, based on its readings of Giddings' bylaws, the special meeting should be held September 5.
Giddings has previously rejected Harnischfeger's $19 a share offer as inadequate.
